title: affected.py tests pin the clean probe at discover start
findings_note: s344 gate 2026-10-17: no test fails if the clean probe moves after the run (implementer mutation M10 survived); the dirty-then-committed test writes its unclean map by hand
boundary: **Not in this slice:** an end-of-run probe (owner decision), or changing map borrowing.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s344 records `"clean"` from a probe taken when the full discover starts. Moving the probe to the end of the run passes every test, so a regression that records a tree cleaned mid-run as clean would go unnoticed.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `tests/test_affected.py`: a test where the tree is dirty at start and clean by the end records `clean: false`; record the unclean sibling map through a real dirty run where practical.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test; confirm it goes red when the probe moves after the run.
2. Replace the hand-written map where practical.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
